initial_candidate_retention: Retain the first complete candidate presented to validation; never substitute selected final candidate when initial is absent.
compile_only_retention: Retain initial if compiled; otherwise replace only with the corrected compiled candidate. This selector accepts compilation booleans only.
original_functional_retention: Use the actual frozen controller selected_source; source must match a recorded candidate or be separately terminal-evaluated.
missing_candidate_handling: Report missing candidate with explicit source absence and terminal outcome; never fill from another task/budget/controller.
unexpected_infrastructure_error: Incomplete, do not code as functional failure
retain_trigger: A replacement in selection relative to first candidate; correction invocation reported separately.
uncertainty: task-cluster bootstrap10000 seed1818; pairs within budget; exact McNemar descriptive
